name: CrowLLM
description: A model gateway with a no-card, zero-priced free model shelf.
overview: CrowLLM says its free lane needs no card or top-up, and is limited to a handful of requests per minute. Free and paid models share an API; check each model price because some IDs ending in :free are earned-credit rather than zero-priced routes. The listed model was advertised as zero-priced when checked. Older operator claims of a daily Discord reward were not confirmed by current pricing. No inference, billing or model identity was independently tested.
free_access: Free lane requires no card or top-up
A handful of requests per minute; exact cap unpublished
Check live pricing; not every :free ID is zero-priced
notes: Base URL https://crowllm.com/v1. Free model availability, rate limits and pricing may change.
